## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** Build a new GDI, then session swap (keep_state). live_inject refuses it: the writer re-points nodes in SONICMDL (no POF0 = pointer layout change) and the PVM lives in VRAM

**Pick whip: partial.** generic profile backend with slot 'player' guessed (no SA2 entity reader or camera profile); live refused for the pointer-layout change, so build + swap

**Live controls:** job sonic_adventure_2 (sa2_mods: status, finish_level, rank, emblems) writes RAM through RetroArch; live_checked False for the DC build. Session swap for models.
